prose: Scott Werner reflects on accidentally becoming a newsletter writer. The plan was demos: short videos proving the AI tools he was hacking together - a TDD pair-programming agent here, a prompt-driven whatever there - actually worked, shipped with runnable code. Somewhere in the middle of showing people, the newsletter became something else.
He is now exploring a paid series of short agentic-coding tutorial videos ($15/month, a 10-15 minute video every two weeks) and floats the idea to readers.
highlights: The newsletter began as demo videos proving small AI tools actually worked
Werner describes the recurring amazement of wiring an AI tool together and seeing it work
He is considering a $15/month agentic-coding tutorial series with a video every two weeks
The piece is a meta note on how the project drifted from its original intent
